title: Tableau circuit computes acceptance
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet whose input-head and work-tape-head positions at each time depend only on the input length. For any $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$ and any binary input $x$ of length $n$, the tableau circuit for $M$ with parameters $n,T$ outputs true exactly when $M$ emits $1$ at some time $s<T$ on input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state binary Turing machine with head positions determined only by input length at each time (obliviousness)
A binary input $x$ represented by an assignment on $n$ variables
